title: Implement error handling for invalid/unsupported JSON
description: Implement error handling to show clear error messages when the imported JSON file is invalid or contains an unsupported diagram model.
acceptanceCriteria: Error message is shown for invalid JSON file
Error message is shown for unsupported diagram model
Application does not crash on invalid import

evidence: Implementation verified: error handling for invalid/unsupported JSON already implemented as part of TASK-030 (deserializer + ImportButton + App error banner). No new code changes needed; git status clean.

Key files: src/components/ImportButton.tsx (catches SyntaxError/ DiagramImportError/unexpected errors, calls onError), src/serialization/diagramDeserializer.ts (throws DiagramImportError for unsupported version, missing fields, unexpected types), src/App.tsx (displays importError in alert banner with dismiss button), src/components/ImportButton.test.tsx (tests invalid JSON, unsupported version, missing diagram root), src/serialization/diagramDeserializer.test.ts (tests all DiagramImportError cases), e2e/import-json.spec.ts (e2e tests for invalid JSON and unsupported version error display).

Acceptance criteria verified: (1) Error message shown for invalid JSON file - ImportButton catches SyntaxError -> 'Invalid JSON file: could not parse the file contents.'; (2) Error message shown for unsupported diagram model - deserializeJson/deserializeDiagram throws DiagramImportError -> ImportButton calls onError(err.message); (3) Application does not crash on invalid import - try/catch in ImportButton handles all error paths.
